; ghostbuster-global.qmd
; Enable system-wide 5-finger screen clear gesture (Library, Documents, Settings)

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/gestures/global/qml/GesturesWindow.qml
    TRAVERSE BaseView#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            TouchAreaClickFilter {
                objectName: "global-5finger-ghostbuster"
                touchArea: root.touchArea
                fingers: 5
                onClick: {
                    EPFramebuffer.clearGhosting();
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
